claim.scope_statement: If (1,alpha,beta) is a Q-basis of a cubic subfield of R, then Littlewood holds with arbitrarily small products along q divisible by any fixed positive D; the approximating numerator for alpha can also be divisible by D and gcd(q,r,s)=1. This follows from de Mathan’s published Theorem1.5, both cubic signatures.
